orangePrompt: Create a production pixel-art animation sprite sheet of THIS EXACT orange-and-white short-haired cat. Preserve exact character, small head versus large but slim body, coat markings, white chest, tail white tip, face, style. Output a 4 columns x 4 rows regular grid, 16 equal square cells, transparent background, no grid lines, no text, no shadow. Each cell contains exactly ONE entire cat; same camera (three quarter facing viewer-right), identical scale and ground baseline, ample empty margins, fixed rear paw ground position within every cell. Read frames left-to-right then top-to-bottom: 1 seated identical reference; 2 begins leaning forward; 3 rises on hind legs; 4 forward forepaw step; 5 both forepaws reach forward; 6 elbows straighten and chest lowers; 7 deeper stretch hips raised; 8 full natural cat play-bow stretch chest low forelegs reaching right; 9 hold stretch; 10 hold with closed content eyes; 11 begins lifting chest; 12 forepaws pull back; 13 hindquarters lower; 14 sits almost upright; 15 settles seated; 16 exactly same seated pose as frame1. Smooth small pose increments, anatomically correct fixed-length limbs, NO elastic body scaling, no extra paws, no duplicated tails. This is one 3.6second single stretch. All16 cells show SAME cat not different designs. Pixel edges crisp and warm game-sprite shading as reference. Use largest supported square sheet resolution.
